article.title: This is Chile, not Haiti
article.excerpt: "There is a certain lawlessness in this country that the government enabled," he said in Spanish. "They don't protect people and people don't respect them and criminal elements get out of control. People also have a high sense of entitlement. They expected the government to have water and power and things under control." There is much more at the link or try
